title: Single exact test-job observation diagnostic
prompt:
Use only the CodeGG `test` and `job` tools. Do not inspect or run the hidden verifier; do not read, write, edit, or use bash.

Call `test` exactly once with `cargo test --offline --locked -p catalog-format`. Copy the exact `job_id` from its result. Then call `job` with action `status` and that exact ID until it reports terminal, with at most five polls. A failed test still has an ID to observe. Never guess an ID, use a task run ID, submit another test, or stop at the submission acknowledgment.

After the terminal status, report the ID and ordered statuses, then stop. This is only a job-observation diagnostic, not H007 qualification.
